newsitem.title: USA: ROSS Technology faces Nasdaq delisting.
newsitem.headline: ROSS Technology faces Nasdaq delisting.

text.p: ROSS Technology Inc said Friday that it has been told that the Nasdaq Stock Market intends to delist the company's common stock.
The company said it is to be delisted since it does not currently meet the net tangible assets requirements of that market.
However, ROSS said it intends to appeal this determination and anticipates that a final determination will be made by Nasdaq in about 30 days.

"The company is in discussions with its parent company, Fujitsu Limited, with regard to alternative actions that could be taken to meet Nasdaq's listing requirements," President and Chief Executive Jack Simpson said in a statement. "No decision has yet been made and Fujitsu has indicated it will respond by August 31."
ROSS, a majority-owned subsidiary of Fujitsu Ltd, is a supplier of microprocessors and system products.
